description: Gases carried from the CAMS global composition forecast as initial and boundary values, transported, vertically mixed and dry-deposited (Wesely), with no chemistry solver: ozone, NO2, CO and SO2.

rows.name: o3

boundary.provenance: CAMS mass mixing ratio per moist air is taken to dry air as q/(1-q_v) with the same frame's CAMS specific humidity, then to ppmv as q_dry * mwdry / M_i * 1e6 with mwdry = 28.966 g/mol (share/module_model_constants.F:34) and M_i this row's molar_mass_g_mol.

wesely.from: hstar chem/module_dep_simple.F:2176, dhr :2453, f0 :2671, dvj 0.175 :2880, dratio and scpr23 :3478-3489; ozone resistance arm rc :1044-1057 (Registry dname o3, registry.chem:1584)

rows.provenance: Registry: state o3 (Registry/registry.chem, dname 'o3', ppmv). floor = WRF epsilc 1.E-16 (chem/module_data_radm2.F:5). default_inflow is WRF-Chem's inflow value for a species the GOCART boundary rule has no explicit case for (chem/module_input_chem_data.F:1295, bdy_chem_value_gocart); it is only ever used when no boundary source is available, and without the CAMS source these rows are refused, so in practice the inflow is CAMS's own value. molar_mass_g_mol from the IUPAC 2013 conventional atomic weights (C 12.011, N 14.007, O 15.999, S 32.06); WRF-Chem carries no common gas molar-mass table for these species. wetdep_ls_alpha 0: large-scale wet scavenging skips gases (chem/module_wetdep_ls.F:39-46). Wesely numbers from dep_init's general (non-MOZART, non-CBM4/CB05) branch, the one a GOCART chem_opt takes. dratio and scpr23 are the float32 values dep_init DERIVES from dvj (the diffusivity corrected to 20 C, then 0.242/dvj and ((0.15/dvj)/0.72)**(2/3), chem/module_dep_simple.F:3478-3489); the column oracle dumps them from the Fortran and tests/test_chem_wesely_wrf471_parity.py asserts these row values equal that dump bit for bit. Carried from CAMS; no photochemistry acts on it (DESIGN 7.4).
